card.title: What Does the Winner Get?
card.instruction: Accept competitive claims, but keep asking who benefits, who pays, and what actually changes after the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So winning best garden means I open it to visitors on Sunday?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Our club keeps the admission money.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And who pays me for opening the gate and cleaning up?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. But as winner, you join the committee that decides how we spend it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Does that committee meet here too? I need to know whether I've won a vote or another room to clean.

mechanism: A accepts the best-garden result but investigates who receives proceeds and who carries the ongoing work.
confusable: Unlike cynicism alone, each follow-up must ask a concrete distribution-of-benefit or cost question.
comparison: S214-b follows a committee reward into possible hosting costs; S214-a follows club display into polishing obligations.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
